test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e5562ba413d8a396e5eaec993d73269d5b0f1fd6e89a93418ee086630657ab.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ab7566e43a68f80b7afe53ef6802524bb39d746f6dbe68d74fa32dbe151193.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Bottom-left, bottom-right and top-right element are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

Middle-right and middle element are interchanging their position.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Bottom-left and middle element are interchanging their position.

Top-right, middle-right and bottom-right element are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8bf3e094186c7c49e385aeca2324542b5d3a397a5719d4f347a5408761e6eee.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d757ad3a8ec832854ae4be062909f20b8d872c5dc309ae44a72890867f6fba30.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
